editorial.name: Twist
editorial.descriptionZh: Twist 是异步沟通工具，用线程把话题收进频道、把未读收进 inbox，主张少打扰；首页按 Organization、Clarity、Focus、Access、Communication、Automation 六段讲，每段配一段可播的产品录屏。
editorial.takeawayZh: 每个卖点配一段可点开播放的录屏
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底衬线大标题 Work communication that won't distract you all day，副文案写 Twist is an async messaging app that makes collaboration easy from anywhere by using threads to organize your conversations.，下面一段客户原话 The best of email, chat, and forums (without all the bullshit) – Our customers。产品图是两张叠在一起的界面：左边手机屏 Inbox，右边桌面端频道 Twist launch campaign planning，标注 64 participants · #Product Launch，第一条消息是 Stijn 发的 Hey all!，中间压着一枚圆形 Play 按钮。往下按 Organization、Clarity、Focus、Access、Communication、Automation 六段展开，Focus 一段讲 The inbox gathers threads in one place，Automation 一段写 Bring all your apps with you when you switch to Twist 并收在 Browse integrations。
editorial.pricing: Freemium：导航有 Pricing 与 Sign up now，首页未列价

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Twist 自己的六段卖点、产品录屏与客户原话（Sign up now 是转化动作），用户拿走的是这一页的排版与论证顺序；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com，属产品与公司官网。
导航只有 Features / Benefits / Why async? / Pricing 与 Log in、Sign up now，页尾另有 /slack-alternative 与 /remote-work-guides 这类内容页，没有可下载的设计资源。
